caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a metal door handle and backplate in pencil on a light beige background. The central focus is a vertical rectangular backplate with decorative edges and two visible screws, to which an arched, ornate handle is attached; a secondary, smaller handle or latch is mounted above the main handle. To the left, an inset rectangular section features a flat, schematic drawing showing the backplate and handle from a frontal view. On the right, another inset provides a side profile of the handle, depicting the curvature and showing a measurement scale in inches beneath the image. The pencil shading emphasizes the metallic texture and dimensionality of the central handle. Small handwritten text is visible at the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Wrought Iron Thumb Latch
